title: rosa lutetiana f. oxyphylla
intro: Rosa lutetiana f. oxyphylla, commonly known as the Paris Rose, is a fragrant, evergreen, and flowering rose species. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve sleep quality. The health benefits of Rosa lutetiana f. oxyphylla include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, anxiety relief, and improved mood.
